subject: Getting an error when accessing Bioclim data

messages.author: 23b74304b58245e3
messages.subject: Getting an error when accessing Bioclim data
parts:
I've been getting an error when I get to the environmental data module in Wallace. I select the WorldClim Bioclim data, but then the screen goes gray and R displays the error:

Warning in utils::download.file(url = aurl, destfile = fn, method = "auto",  :
  InternetOpenUrl failed: 'A connection with the server could not be established'
Warning: Error in utils::download.file: cannot open URL 'https://biogeo.ucdavis.edu/data/climate/worldclim/1_4/grid/cur/bio_5m_bil.zip'

Thanks,
Justin Bastow

messages.author: d73691b565754184
messages.subject: Re: Getting an error when accessing Bioclim data
parts:
Hi Justin,

Thanks for reporting this issue. As mentioned by @mesquitajoanes, all links of worldclim data are falling. In the meantime, you can use the user-specified option to define Environmental data on Wallace. I generate a temporary dropbox folder to get Worldclim 1.4 data (10 min and 5 min resolution).

Let me know if that option works for you.

Best,
Gonzalo
